snippet.title: Valve's Deadlock teaser, an upcoming multiplayer shooter
snippet.description:
Valve's upcoming multiplayer shooter has been an open secret for months. The developer remained weirdly secretive about the project as players leaked mountains of information and footage from it. Valve is now ready to admit that the game exists but hasn't given it the fanfare expected of a newly announced game. The project remains in early development.

More information:
https://www.techspot.com/tag/deadlock/
